method: Playwright performance.spec.ts, one warm session, 1440×1000 UI and native 1920×1080 canvas
notes: First-frame render includes image fetch/decode and initial compositing.
Cached render samples are measured by the Studio around renderFrameToCanvas.
The 34.1 ms initial sample is retained in the percentile calculation; most later cached samples are sub-millisecond.
The performance.memory values are rounded Chrome JS heap snapshots and are not a full GPU or canvas-memory measurement.
Playback advances by elapsed time at a 24 FPS target; the measured effective rate was approximately 22.3 frames per second over the sample window.
